features.title: Wedding Theme — Classic Antique Gold Palette
features.description: Two new theme variants (wedding-light, wedding-dark) registered across all theming surfaces; theme count 24 → 26
features.details:
A classic Wedding theme palette — two variants (Day + Evening) built around antique gold (#C5A55A) and silver (#A8A9AD) tones, bringing the total theme count to 26.

  • wedding-light (Day) — Warm cream backgrounds (#FFFDF7), antique gold primary (#C5A55A), antique silver secondary (#A8A9AD), dark warm text (#2C2416), warm tan borders (#E8DCC8), and warm gold-tinted shadows for a timeless, refined feel
  • wedding-dark (Evening) — Deep midnight navy backgrounds (#12121F / #1A1A2E), antique gold primary with lighter hover (#D4B66A) following dark-mode convention, warm cream text (#F0E8D8), indigo borders (#2A2A40), and subtle gold-glow shadows
  • wedding.css — Legacy compound-selector variant (.dm-theme-wedding + dark override) for projects using the base/variant pattern

Registered across all theming surfaces: Theme Roller dropdown (Day ☀️ / Evening 🌙 labels), layout variant dot selector (count 24 → 26), themes showcase card grid, Kickstart Builder theme picker, and the Domma.theme API (listThemes() / listBases()). PhpStorm IDE type definitions updated to include 'wedding' in ThemeVariant.

features.title: Mint Theme — Fresh Spearmint Colour Palette
features.description: Two new theme variants (mint-light, mint-dark) registered across all theming surfaces; theme count 22 → 24
features.details:
A fresh Mint theme palette — two variants (light + dark) built around cool spearmint and seafoam green tones, bringing the total theme count to 24.

  • mint-light — Rich eucalyptus primary (#2e9e6e), seafoam secondary (#5b8a7a), white surfaces with a subtle mint-tinted alt background (#f0faf5), near-black forest text (#1a2e25), and soft celadon borders (#c8e6d8)
  • mint-dark — Deep slate-900 backgrounds with a dark mint-tinted surface (#1e3a2f), bright spearmint primary (#6dd5a8) for contrast, mint-tinted text (#d4f5e4), and dark teal borders (#2a4a3a)
  • mint.css — Legacy compound-selector variant (.dm-theme-mint + dark override) for projects using the base/variant pattern

Registered across all theming surfaces: Theme Roller dropdown, layout variant dot selector (count updated to 24), themes showcase card grid, and the Domma.theme API (listThemes() / listBases()). Download page swatch corrected to use proper .theme-swatch classes and updated to reflect 12 colour families.

features.title: Layout System — Auto-Generated Breadcrumbs
features.description: Frosted glass breadcrumb pill auto-generated from the URL, overlaid top-left on hero sections across showcase and public pages
features.details:
The layout system now derives breadcrumb navigation automatically from window.location.pathname — no per-page markup needed.

  • renderBreadcrumbs(config, depth) — Creates a <nav class="layout-breadcrumbs-pill"> wrapper prepended into the .hero element (or a fallback bar below the navbar on hero-less pages); uses a two-layer DOM so the Domma Breadcrumbs component's class overwrite doesn't disturb the pill styling
  • buildBreadcrumbItems(config, depth) — Splits the pathname, maps each segment through a built-in label dictionary (dom → DOM, http → HTTP, spa → SPA, theme-roller → Theme Roller, etc.), title-cases anything not in the map, and extracts the last crumb's label from <title> (stripping Domma suffixes)
  • Preset config — breadcrumbs.enabled: true for showcase:subpage, showcase:effects, showcase:element, and public; false for landing, index, minimal, admin, and demo presets
  • Responsive — Pill shrinks at ≤576px

bugFixes.title: Forms — Checkbox Label Duplication
bugFixes.description: Checkbox fields no longer receive a redundant standalone label element; label rendering is now skipped for checkbox inputs
bugFixes.details: The label injection logic in forms.js previously emitted a visible <label> element for every field type, including checkboxes. Checkboxes embed their label within their own markup, so the extra element caused doubled text. The label-rendering path now explicitly excludes type === 'checkbox'.

bugFixes.title: Breadcrumbs — item.text vs item.label
bugFixes.description: buildBreadcrumbItems() was building items with a 'label' property; the Domma Breadcrumbs component reads 'text', causing [object Object] to render
bugFixes.details: Breadcrumbs._render() reads item.text || item (line 4912 of elements.js). The initial implementation used label as the property name, producing [object Object] in the rendered breadcrumb trail. All item objects now use text.

housekeeping.title: Breadcrumbs CSS — Moved from JS to elements.css (v0.19.1)
housekeeping.description: Inline runtime styles for .dm-breadcrumbs-item, .dm-breadcrumbs-separator, and .dm-breadcrumbs-link moved to elements.css as static rules; separator class name corrected
housekeeping.details: Added in v0.19.1. The _injectStyles() method in the Breadcrumbs class was injecting a <style> block at runtime. These rules have been moved to src/css/elements.css as static declarations. The separator selector was also corrected from .dm-breadcrumb-separator to .dm-breadcrumbs-separator.
